summary: If the same misuse of power would still be possible with someone else in charge, replacing the person has not solved the part of the problem most likely to repeat.
body: If the same misuse of power would still be possible with someone else in charge, replacing the person has not solved the part of the problem most likely to repeat. When Saturn trines Pluto, deeper change becomes possible because you can address the agreement, rule, access, responsibility, or check on authority that made the old pattern easy to maintain. The goal is not simply to feel better about who holds the position now. Change the conditions that allowed the problem to happen so the next person has less room to recreate it.
